questions.text: We're a property management company with maintenance crews on call. Does email-to-text work for after-hours emergencies?
I run IT for a small manufacturer and our equipment emails fault codes. Can those go straight to the on-call tech as a text?
Can a school office text substitute teachers from a shared Outlook account without everyone installing an app?
We're a 12-person HVAC company. Is email-to-text enough for us, or will we outgrow it within a year?
